summary: Radio transmissions to stop during the two-minute silence on Remembrance Day at aerodromes EGPX and EGTT, except emergencies.
text:
VARIOUS AD ARE TO OBSERVE A TEMPORARY CESSATION OF RADIO FREQ FOR 
THE TWO MINUTE SILENCE ON REMEMBRANCE DAY. DURING THE TWO MINUTE 
SILENCE NO RADIO TRANSMISSIONS WILL BE MADE, EXCEPT IN AN 
EMERGENCY. MORE INFO IS TO BE PROVIDED BY RELEVANT ATC AND FIS
